description: Implement an environment variable configuration that allows specific hostnames or IP addresses to bypass SSRF protection checks when used as webhook targets. This enables self-hosted instances to send webhooks to private network destinations while maintaining security for all other webhook URLs.
functional_requirements: Parse NEXT_PRIVATE_WEBHOOK_SSRF_BYPASS_HOSTS environment variable into an immutable Set of unique, lowercased hostnames/IPs at module initialization
Add a bypass check at the beginning of the webhook URL validation function that skips all private IP checks if the URL's hostname matches an entry in the whitelist
Maintain existing strict SSRF protection behavior when the environment variable is empty, unset, or when hostnames don't match the whitelist
Update environment configuration documentation to include the new variable with usage examples
